results.note: Ukrinform (14 Nov 08:38 Kyiv) repeats the Air Force morning summary: from 18:00 on 13 Nov Russia attacked with 96 strike UAVs (61 jet-powered Shaheds, Gerberas, Parodiya decoys), below 170.

Ukrinform (15 Nov 03:39 Kyiv) reports ombudsman Lubinets still discussing with his Russian counterpart the mechanism for an exchange of at least 1,000 people, and Novinky (15 Nov) the same, so no exchange took place on 13–14 Nov.
Space.com live blog and SpaceNews ('Starship launches on 15th test, calls off booster catch', 13 Nov): Flight 15 lifted off from Starbase on Fri 13 Nov at 22:47 UTC (16:47 CST), inside the window.
SpaceNews and Space.com: Super Heavy ended its boostback early on a low-fuel-mass alarm, aborted the tower catch and diverted to a water landing in the Gulf of Mexico on 13 Nov.

Space.com and SpaceNews ('SpaceX catches Starship upper stage', 14 Nov): the Ship was caught by the Starbase tower's chopstick arms on Sat 14 Nov at about 21:20 UTC (15:20 CST), before the 23:59 CST deadline; BBC also reports the catch.

SPR site carried no readable results, so from EC-announced results reported by FMT ("OFFICIAL: BN-PN wins 24 seats in Melaka, PH 4") and NST/Malay Mail: the BN–PN pact won 24 of the 28 seats in polling held on 14 Nov, meeting the 24-seat threshold.

SPR site carried no readable results, so from EC-announced results reported by FMT and The Edge ("PH routed in Melaka, retains just four seats"): Pakatan Harapan won 4 of 28 seats (DAP’s four urban seats), below the 5-seat threshold.

None of the three 14 Nov texts on vatican.va (coronation rite in Chiclayo, Mass at Santa Cruz de Succhabamba, St Toribio prayer meeting in Zaña), in English or Spanish, contains a corrupt-/corrup-/corromp- word, and no Vatican News quote of such an off-script remark that day was found.
The official regional table shows Grand Est at 17% for 14 Nov at 17h (the only 14 Nov column), below the 23% threshold.

Resolved from best available evidence (ukmto.org not readable): gCaptain (16 Nov) lists the UKMTO-reported attacks of 15 Nov (an Indian-notified tanker attack in the Gulf) and 16 Nov (two tankers near Khasab) with none dated 14 Nov, Arab News (15 Nov) has UKMTO speaking of the Indian report only on Sunday, and the Saturday tanker "mine strike" was claimed only by Iran's navy (gCaptain/Reuters, 14 Nov), which does not count; read as no UKMTO/JMIC-reported incident occurring on 14 Nov.

ENB Vol. 12 No. 907 (daily report for Saturday 14 Nov) states under "Closure of the SBs" that SBI 65 and SBSTA 65 adopted their reports and "the SBs closed at 12:48 am on 15 November", after the 23:59 deadline; held is false because the closing plenaries ran past midnight out of the window.
